visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black hair, wearing a dark blazer over a collared shirt, sits at a table. He is holding the roof of a detailed LEGO Japanese Himeji Castle model, gesturing as he speaks directly to the camera with an engaging expression. Behind him is a plain wall with a decorative poster on the left. (2) Close-up shot of a hand placing a small yellow-masted Japanese flag on a map of the world, specifically over the island of Taiwan. The lighting is bright and even. (3) The man continues his explanation, using animated hand movements and pointing gestures. Large, colorful text overlays appear periodically, emphasizing his points. (4) A quick montage sequence shows soldiers in modern tactical gear moving through an indoor range with smoke, followed by a transition to a historical black-and-white archival photograph of soldiers lined up in a field during the 1940s. (5) Graphic effects of red blood droplets appear on screen as the man talks about 'blood letters.' A close-up shows a person's hand with fingers coated in red ink or blood pressed against a glass surface. (6) Another archival photo appears, showing four young men in military uniforms of the Japanese colonial era holding a flag. (7) The man presents a vertical poster for a musical titled 'Tropical Angel' (熱帶天使) featuring a dramatic, glowing portal and planes. He concludes with a call-to-action, pointing toward the bottom of the frame.
